    raise NotImplementedError("Implement the label specification.")","new":"def slugify(text):
    # Lowercase the input
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Check if there are any ASCII letters or digits
    has_ascii = any(c.isalnum() and c.isascii() for c in text)
    if not has_ascii:
        return ""
    
    # Replace each run of non-ASCII a-z/0-9 characters with a hyphen
    result = []
    prev_was_hyphen = False
    
    for char in text:
        if char.isalnum() and char.isascii():  # ASCII letter or digit
            if not prev_was_hyphen:
                result.append(char)
            prev_was_hyphen = False
        else:  # non-ASCII a-z/0-9 character (space, punctuation, etc.)
            if not prev_was_hyphen:
                result.append('-')
            prev_was_hyphen = True
    
    slug = ''.join(result)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    
    return slug"}
